references.text: Earlier in the same chapter, God gives the command to bring the blasphemer outside the camp and stone him, which is carried out here.
A similar case where the Lord commands that a lawbreaker be brought outside the camp and stoned, this time for breaking the Sabbath.
The law concerning the stoning of idolaters outside the city gate follows the same pattern of execution outside the community.
The command to stone anyone who leads others into idolatry shows the same method of punishment for serious sins against God.
Achan was stoned after Israel carried out what the Lord had commanded, just as the children of Israel here obeyed the Lord's command.
Jesus suffered outside the city gate, which connects to the pattern of execution outside the camp.
